packageRules.description: Automerge minor/patch updates and pinned versions for devDependencies
Group Serenity/JS package updates to prevent PR noise
Group WebdriverIO package updates to prevent PR noise
Group React ecosystem package updates to keep them aligned

Group Vite with its plugins: @vitejs/plugin-react imports vite/internal, so a plugin major cannot build against an older Vite major. Ungrouped, the plugin PR fails on its own and only goes green once Vite lands first.
